newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes higher at 1,002.80.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes higher at 1,002.80.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.2 higher at 1,002.80 as dollar-sales by oil exporters and banks lifted it in trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

They said petrodollars entering the market late in the session combined with sporadic sales of greenbacks by banks that had overextended their dollar positions since last week to allow the peso to close higher for the first time since last Thursday.
Dealers reported 400 trades for a total of $153.9 million and said the peso held in a 1,000.40 to 1,003 range.
